name: the-masha-game
description: Online multiplayer game of the masha game (little papers, associations)

scripts.start: npm run build-css && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider elm-app start
scripts.start:test: npm run build-css && BROWSER=none NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider elm-app start
scripts.build: npm run build-css && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider elm-app build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:config
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.verify: npm run test:unit && npm run test:config && npm run test:functions && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting

author: Marija Dordevic
